SELECT OVERRIDE_ID, VERSION_ID, ACCOUNT_CODE, MODULE,
             DIM_PRIMARY, DIM_SECONDARY, DIM_TERTIARY, DIM_QUATERNARY,
             PERIOD, OVERRIDE_TYPE, PREVIOUS_VALUE, NEW_VALUE,
             CONFIDENCE, RATIONALE, SIGNAL_SOURCE, PROPOSAL_ID,
             BREAKBACK_METHOD, PARENT_OVERRIDE_ID, SEVERITY,
             USER_ID, CREATED_AT
      FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_OVERRIDE
      WHERE VERSION_ID = 3 AND MODULE = 'revenue' AND IS_ACTIVE = TRUE
      ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
